rules: Unrationed Event. Play at any time. Not an action.
Destroy up to 3 Infection cards of one city. They must be in the Infection discard pile, and they must all be copies of that one city.

The card may be played between epidemic step 2 and step 3. Step 2 discards the bottom Infection card after stripping that city. Step 3 shuffles the Infection discard onto the Infection deck. Cards destroyed in that window are not part of that shuffle.
notes: Given to a player when Package 4 is opened (P4-01b).
